reviews.text: Chema is a true professional. He adapts to the pace of both dog and owner. The results after the procedure were very positive. He answers questions and provides follow-up care. Highly recommended.

I trained my dog ​​with Adiestracam and I couldn't be happier. In the first interview, Chema explained that the goal was to achieve a well-balanced dog and what that balance truly meant. That's precisely what convinced me.

During the classes, Bender and I have learned together and overcome difficulties such as pulling on the leash during walks, urinating in the house, destroying things, and restlessness. He's a very high-strung hunting dog, but now he's much calmer at home. He's learned that the house is his safe place, not a park, just as Chema explained to me from the beginning.

The change has been enormous, and now Bender and I are doing perfectly. I highly recommend Adiestracam. Thank you so much, Chema!
100% recommended. Chema is a true professional who has shared a wealth of knowledge with us, enabling us to raise a well-balanced dog today.

When we started with Adiestracan, my Spanish Water Dog Falkor (who was one year old at the time) was quite insecure. He reacted to stimuli, jumped on people, tried to bite strangers, was terrified of noisy places or when a shop's shutter suddenly closed, and would also react and try to bite other male dogs. Now Falkor is 1 year and 6 months old and has completed 5 sessions with Chema. He's a much more confident dog. He's no longer afraid of noises, doesn't try to bite, doesn't jump on people, and regulates his emotions much better. We still have work to do, but doing it with Adiestracan has been one of the best decisions we could have made to help Falkor and us have a happier life. 100% recommended.
A very professional and attentive service. They provide clear guidelines and useful tools that work very well in everyday life. Thank you so much for your help, Chema 😊

We contacted Chema on the recommendation of a friend because of problems with our year-and-a-half-old dachshund. From the very first moment, we received personalized attention, tailored to our dog's needs. Today, after several training sessions, Dante is a completely different dog. He has overcome his fears and is now a perfect companion.

We are very grateful to Chema for achieving this behavioral change, which we thought was impossible.

The training sessions we've had aimed at helping our dog Peggy develop calmer behavior have been excellent.

Chema's approach to and delivery of these training sessions is fantastic.

It's been a great help.

In our personal experience, the training didn't work at all. We contacted them because our dog was always overexcited and behaved very badly with visitors and when left alone at home. The diagnosis was that he had poor emotional regulation, and the main solution, among many other measures, was to stop giving him so much attention.
Six months later, there are very few things in which I can say the service has been helpful. I think the six included sessions are insufficient (assuming they're even useful) and that perhaps this number should be more tailored to each individual case, not contingent on having to pay for them separately. After three months, I contacted them again (after quite a bit of persistence) to discuss the little to no progress with the trainer. We had a conversation in which he told me what we were probably doing wrong and what we needed to be stricter about. Meanwhile, the only proposed solution was to keep the dog locked up while I was alone (the entire workday, every day) or medicated with anti-anxiety medication, something my veterinarian strongly advised against when I consulted him. In my opinion, these being the only two options simply means the training has failed.

From that moment until now, we've been much stricter, but to this day my dog ​​still destroys things when left alone, even though we ignore him when we get home and haven't scolded him for months, as we were told.

Without questioning the trainer's skill, since I assume it may have worked for other dogs and simply didn't work for me, there are many other details that demonstrate disinterest and a serious lack of professionalism in the service, such as not hearing about the food order, which was delayed for 10 days, or taking weeks or even months to get a response in the "lifetime support" WhatsApp group offered along with the training. This group has yet to receive a response to my last message.

We've tried giving the trainer more time, patience, and opportunities to follow his advice, but I feel like I've wasted my money, as most of the problems I contacted him about persist.

Chema has been a huge help with our puppy. In a very short time, he corrected certain behaviors and helped her improve her conduct and overcome some fears. He gave us very useful tips and exercises to work on both with her in class and at home on our own. We especially want to highlight Chema's approachability; he's very friendly and clear in his explanations. We highly recommend him!!
Thanks Chema for your help!! Great people and professionals!!
I highly recommend them. Great professionalism and commitment. Excellent work.

A great experience with Chema. He has helped us a lot with our dog, who came from a difficult situation. He gave us very precise advice to continue his training, and in just two months the dog has improved tremendously. Highly recommended.
The best thing we've done is call Chema! My only regret is not doing it sooner.

Our dog, a miniature English Bull Terrier, has responded wonderfully to Chema's training. He has learned to respect his 15-year-old brother, a Parson Russell Terrier. A highly recommended trainer. Charming and super professional. We will continue to use his services if needed. My sincerest congratulations on his excellent work.

We had a problem with our puppy, who had grown up and was behaving aggressively towards the other adult dog in the house. The situation has changed since Adiestracan started working with him, and now it's a haven of peace. Many thanks to Adiestracan, and especially to Chema.

We are very, very happy and recommend them 100%.
Chema helped us a lot with Migas. We've learned how to react to many situations. I recommend him 100%.

We contacted Chema because we adopted a dog who had separation anxiety, and it couldn't have gone better.

Thanks to the guidance he provided, we've begun to understand our dog and give him the tools to gradually cope better when we're away from home and he has to be alone. He also gave us tips for walks and for interacting with him.

We are very grateful because, with his professional, respectful approach based on positive reinforcement, our dog has improved remarkably and is now much calmer and more confident.
Chema did a great job with Migas and with us, of course. You can already see that he's calmer on walks and more confident. I recommend him 100%.
Chema is very nice, but he hasn't been able or hasn't known how to solve our dog's fear.

I want to express my deepest gratitude to Chema, our dog trainer who contacted us when we asked for help at Adiestracan. Thank you for all the progress we've made with my dog. From day one, he instilled confidence, patience, and professionalism, and it shows in every session.

My dog ​​has improved tremendously: he's now more balanced, obeys better, and above all, seems happy and calm. Chema hasn't just worked with him, but also with me, teaching me how to understand him and communicate effectively.

Thanks to his dedication, care, and expertise, living together at home is much easier and more enjoyable. I recommend Chema 100%,

not only as a trainer, but as someone who truly loves and respects dogs.
He has helped us a lot; Blue is a different dog, docile and calm on walks...
A truly excellent job, planned from day one and realistic about the facts. They focus not only on the problem but also on its root cause. Highly recommended. Delighted ♥️♥️
My experience with Adiestracan has been very good. Chema is a professional with extensive knowledge, and they helped me raise a well-balanced puppy.

My experience with Chema has been incredible. I had been working with a trainer who used rather punitive methods, and I wanted to change things up, so I contacted AdiedtraCan. Chema showed me the complete opposite: how to train your dog using positive reinforcement, strengthening the bond with your furry friend even during corrections. From the second day, my dog ​​already loved him and was very happy to see him. He has definitely redefined my concept of dog training. I am very grateful.

We hired Adiestracan because of our dog's aggression and anxiety problems, and Chema has helped us understand our dog, given us guidance, and is always available to answer our questions. Our relationship with our dog has changed; there's a better atmosphere at home, and above all, our dog has found a peace and tranquility he didn't have before.

We have an extremely intelligent toy poodle and decided to train him because his behavior was becoming difficult to manage due to anxiety and attachment issues. We chose Adiestracan on the recommendation of some friends and we're very happy with it. After the sessions, we've noticed our dog is much more focused and balanced, with less anxiety and more independent. And although we still have a lot of work ahead of us, Chema has taught us the necessary techniques to continue training our little one.

I highly recommend them!!!
Fantastic! I've finally found the perfect place. Super professional and friendly. Chema understood our problem perfectly and helped us immensely. Thank you so much. 100% recommended.

Chema has been incredibly kind and helpful, adapting perfectly to our needs as a family and giving us the tools we needed to better understand our dog. The results have been excellent, and our dog is calmer and happier than ever!

It's been a pleasure meeting Chema. He's taught us so much, and we've seen tremendous improvement, although we still need to work with our Malinois. He's made us feel comfortable and earned our trust, since everything he says and teaches us has a purpose. He takes the necessary time to do his job, and his training method is incredibly respectful. In every session, I've asked him to record his voice for me because what he's achieved with Capi in each session is amazing. Even though the sessions have ended, he's shown us that he's still with us and will always be by our side. I hope he keeps it up because I'm taking him with me as both a trainer and a person. I recommend him 100%. Before meeting him, I researched and asked many trainers, but he won me over from the very first moment.
You do a fantastic job, and I'm so grateful. I'm sorry for being such a pest; you have admirable patience.

It has been a pleasure meeting you. Without a doubt, Chema is an exceptional person who is very involved with owners on a human level. In my particular case, he offered services, advice, and all the wisdom he has developed throughout his career as a dog trainer. Furthermore, regarding the training and behavior correction of my Belgian Shepherd, he has been excellent, always working from the perspective of our dog's peace of mind and showing us how to do things right so we can enjoy our dog. He is incredible, and I recommend him 100% without a doubt.
